# Victoria Clara Swart

> Multilingual web designer and brand strategist in Rome. Websites, copy and SEO in German, English, Italian, Spanish and Danish.

Multilingual web designer, brand strategist and language teacher based in Rome,
Italy. Works in German, English, Italian, Spanish and Danish. VAT: IT18420501001.

## What she does

- Web design & development: Fast, multilingual websites and shops, designed, written and coded by one person. From €900. (https://victoriaswart.com/web-design/)
- Strategy & SEO: Positioning, messaging and search visibility for businesses that sell across borders. (https://victoriaswart.com/strategy/)
- Languages: Lessons, translation and cultural adaptation, and moderation for international events. (https://victoriaswart.com/languages/)

## Pricing, stated publicly

- One-page site: from €900. A musician, a tradesperson, a small B&B.
- Multi-page site: €1,500 to €2,500. Several pages, a clear structure, room to grow.
- Shop on Shopify: from €3,000. A real shop, built on a custom theme.
- Each extra language: +€300. Written by me, not machine-translated.
- Care plan: €60 per month. Hosting checks, updates and small edits each month.
- Small changes outside a plan: €50 per hour. For anything that comes up later.
- Local visibility setup: €450 one-off. Google Business Profile, basic SEO, reviews.
- Website and visibility check: €150. Ninety minutes on your site and how findable it is, with a written list of what to fix first.
- Local visibility setup: €450. Google Business Profile, basic SEO and a reviews routine, set up once and yours to keep.
- Brand strategy and positioning: On request. What makes you distinct, who you speak to, your core message and tone.
- Multilingual communication strategy: On request. How your message adapts for each language and market.
- Ongoing strategic support: On request. A thinking partner every month, for businesses that want one.
- One to one lesson: €35. Sixty minutes, online.
- Ten lessons: €320. Booked together.
- Business or aviation English: €45. Sixty minutes, online. Specialist preparation.
- Moderation and MC: from €400. Quoted per event.

## Selected work

- Seabreeze (Houseboat holiday rental, Alghero, Sardinia, 2026): A houseboat holiday rental needed a site that turns visitors into booking enquiries, for guests arriving from across Europe. https://victoriaswart.com/work/seabreeze/
- EQM Sellier (Artisan saddlery, Adro, Franciacorta, 2026): A workshop making bespoke saddles, bridles and competition trunks by hand needed to move from an old WordPress site to a real shop, without losing the consultation-first way it sells a saddle that costs several thousand euros. https://victoriaswart.com/work/eqm-sellier/
- Graziano Tumbarello (Saxophonist, Marsala, Sicily, 2026): A professional saxophonist booked for weddings and events needed a site that answers a couple's questions and gets them to message him. https://victoriaswart.com/work/graziano-tumbarello/
- Emergency home services company (Emergency plumbing, heating and electrical, Rome, Fregene and Fiumicino, 2026): A home services company offering 24-hour emergency call-outs needed to be found by people searching in a panic, and needed a way to track the leads that came in. https://victoriaswart.com/work/home-services/
- La Dolce Vita Luxury Experience (Italian luxury concierge, Italy, 2025 to 2026): A speculative concept for a luxury concierge service, aimed at travellers who expect access rather than packages. The business was never launched. https://victoriaswart.com/work/la-dolce-vita/
- victoriaswart.com (My own site, Rome, 2026): My own site, rebuilt to show what I actually do instead of describing it. https://victoriaswart.com/work/victoriaswart-com/
